name: Flowers Garden
description: Sixteen blooming pictures: a smiling sunflower, three daisies, a rose, a watering can, a ladybug, flower pots, a frog on a lily pad, a garden gate, a hummingbird, a birdhouse, a bouquet, a dandelion, a caterpillar, a wheelbarrow, a pansy and a rainbow.
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly subject, centered, alone on the page with at most a small grassy mound or ground line; no extra background flowers, plants or clouds beyond what the subject describes. About 16 large closed areas to color. Eyes are small solid black dots, smile is one short line. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.

pages.name: Sunflower Smile
pages.subject: one giant sunflower with a big round smiling face in the middle, a single ring of ten wide petals, a thick stem and two big leaves, standing on a small grassy mound

pages.name: Daisy Trio
pages.subject: three daisies of different heights side by side, each with only five wide round petals and a round middle, their stems growing from one small grassy mound

pages.name: Rose Friend
pages.subject: one big simple rose made of four large rounded petals, with a smiling face, a straight stem and two wide leaves

pages.name: Watering Can
pages.subject: a smiling watering can pouring five big round water drops onto two flowers

pages.name: Ladybug Leaf
pages.subject: a round ladybug with six big round spots sitting on one giant leaf next to a flower

pages.name: Pot Trio
pages.subject: three simple flower pots in a row, not overlapping, each pot one plain shape with no rim, each holding one flower with four wide round petals and a round middle

pages.name: Frog Lily
pages.subject: a smiling frog sitting on a round lily pad next to a big water lily flower with wide petals

pages.name: Garden Gate
pages.subject: a wide wooden picket gate with three pointed boards and one crossbar, standing on a wide grassy mound, with one big fully closed flower with five round petals and two leaves on each side

pages.name: Hummingbird Sip
pages.subject: a round hummingbird with one big wing hovering beside one large trumpet-shaped flower on a thick stem with one leaf, nothing else on the page

pages.name: Birdhouse Bloom
pages.subject: a birdhouse with a round door and a pointed roof on a post, surrounded by three big flowers

pages.name: Bouquet Bow
pages.subject: a bouquet of three big flowers, each with four wide round petals and a round middle, their stems gathered together and tied with a big bow

pages.name: Dandelion Puff
pages.subject: one dandelion clock drawn as a big circle filled with seven large round seed puffs, on a thick stem with one wide leaf, and one seed floating away

pages.name: Caterpillar Climb
pages.subject: a wide picture filling most of the page: a big smiling caterpillar made of five large round segments curled around a thick flower stem, one giant flower with five round petals at the top, two big leaves on the stem and a wide grassy mound at the bottom

pages.name: Flower Wheelbarrow
pages.subject: a wheelbarrow with one big wheel full of four big flowers

pages.name: Pansy Face
pages.subject: one giant pansy with five big rounded petals and a smiling face in the middle, with two leaves

pages.name: Rainbow Flowers
pages.subject: a rainbow of five wide bands arching over a row of four big flowers
